gloss: to run around trying to escape; to flee in all directions

definitions.gloss: to run around trying to escape; to flee in all directions; to keep dodging
definitions.explanation: To repeatedly flee or move around in an attempt to avoid being caught, found, or confronted. Suggests sustained, frantic evasion rather than a single act of running away.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}が{家中|いえじゅう}を{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: The dog ran around the house trying to escape.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}は{警察|けいさつ}から{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: The suspect is running around trying to evade the police.

examples.japanese: {借金|しゃっきん}{取|と}りから{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}る{生活|せいかつ}にはもう{疲|つか}れた。
examples.english: I'm tired of a life spent dodging debt collectors.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive godan verb. Compound of {逃|に}げる (to flee) + {回|まわ}る (to go around). The 〜{回|まわ}る suffix adds a sense of doing the action repeatedly or all over.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜から{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}る: to keep running from ~
- {責任|せきにん}から{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}る: to keep dodging responsibility
- あちこち{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}る: to run around here and there

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {逃|に}げる: to flee — single act of escaping; no sense of repeated movement
- {逃|に}げ{出|だ}す: to break out, run away — emphasizes the start of fleeing
- {振|ふ}り{切|き}る: to shake off — succeed in escaping a pursuer
